name: graph-mempalace
description: Knowledge base for a project's past conversations and code: MemPalace holds the verbatim exchanges, two Graphify graphs route to them, and hooks keep both current.

plugins.name: graph-mempalace
plugins.description: Builds a knowledge base from a project's own conversation transcripts and code, and answers questions about past work from the verbatim exchange or the file rather than from a summary.
